summary: Pierre 在 ethresear.ch 发表 Towards Native Post-Quantum Private ETH，梳理在 L1 内置后量子隐私需要做的密码学工作，并指出仅防范“先收集后解密”并不够。soispoke 提交 EIP-8081 修改，提议 EIP-8272 recent roots 进入 Hegotá。forshtat 为 EIP-7906 加入 POST_TX frame 模式和 TXDIFF 操作码并合并。Vitalik 把 EIP-7864 调整为分区二叉树（PBT）设计。aelowsson 分析低、零、负发行政策下的发行抵扣与加重罚金。

items.title: ethresear.ch：Towards Native Post-Quantum Private ETH
items.note: 22:53（Pierre）。L1 strawmap 把 L1 原生的后量子私密转账列为北极星目标。目前已部署的隐私方案依赖椭圆曲线原语或不令人满意的硬件假设；有人认为防范“先收集、后解密”（HNDL）攻击就够了，但文章指出，一旦出现具备密码学意义的量子计算机，攻击者可能实施无法察觉的攻击并造成灾难性损失，届时 turnstile 等恢复机制需要大量社会层协调。文章以 Zcash Sapling（约 62 万枚屏蔽 ZEC）为例，说明交付后量子屏蔽 ETH 所需的工作远不止切换证明系统。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Towards Native Post-Quantum Private ETH
items.note_en: 22:53 (Pierre). The L1 strawmap lists L1-native private post-quantum transfers as a north star. Privacy solutions in production today rely on elliptic curve primitives or unsatisfying hardware assumptions; some argue protecting against harvest-now-decrypt-later (HNDL) attacks is enough, but the post notes that once a cryptographically relevant quantum computer exists, adversaries could carry out undetectable attacks with catastrophic losses, and recovery mechanisms such as turnstiles would require heavy social layer coordination. Using Zcash Sapling (about 620k shielded ZEC) as an example, it shows that delivering post-quantum shielded ETH takes far more than switching proof systems.

items.title: ethresear.ch：低、零、负发行政策下发行抵扣与加重罚金的性质
items.note: 22:57（aelowsson）。以太坊正在讨论降低发行。若把每单位基础奖励降到接近零，执行 attestation 职责的激励就会消失，有两种保留激励的方案：在 epoch 处理时施加“发行抵扣”，或加重罚金。文章分析两者的性质，不提出具体奖励曲线。
items.title_en: ethresear.ch: Properties of issuance offsets and increased penalties under low/zero/negative issuance policies
items.note_en: 22:57 (aelowsson). Ethereum is debating an issuance reduction. If the base reward per increment goes toward zero, the incentive to perform attestation duties disappears; two ways to keep it are an "issuance offset" applied during epoch processing, or increased penalties. The post analyzes both and does not propose a specific reward curve.

summary_en: Pierre published Towards Native Post-Quantum Private ETH on ethresear.ch, laying out the cryptographic work needed to enshrine post-quantum privacy in the L1 and arguing that protecting against harvest-now-decrypt-later alone is not enough. soispoke submitted an EIP-8081 change proposing EIP-8272 recent roots for Hegotá. forshtat added a POST_TX frame mode and a TXDIFF opcode to EIP-7906, both merged. Vitalik adjusted EIP-7864 to the partitioned binary tree (PBT) design. aelowsson analyzed issuance offsets and increased penalties under low, zero or negative issuance.
